extracted.name: Savory Spinach Casserole
extracted.description: This spinach, cream cheese, and Parmesan cheese casserole is a creamy, comforting, easy, savory side dish perfect for the holidays or potluck dinner.
instruction_lines: Preheat the oven to 350 degrees F (175 degrees C).
Combine cream cheese and milk in a mixing bowl; mix until blended. Spoon spinach into 1-quart casserole, top with cream cheese mixture, and sprinkle with Parmesan cheese.
Bake in the preheated oven for 20 minutes.
